given: a stock record is open on the stock view
when: the warehouse team member reads the record
then: the opaque combined tracking code is no longer shown anywhere on the stock view
architectural_notes: E2E: negative-presence assertion on the rendered SPA stock view. The boundary (app/routes/, renders_via react) no longer emits a combined tracking code (the column is dropped by the S1 migration), so the SPA stock-view component has nothing to render for it. Owner module is the SPA stock-view component; realizes the design by ensuring the JSON contract carries only batch_number/serial_number and the component template contains no combined-code element. No cross-cutting owner needed; this is a rendering-contract outcome.

independence.rationale: AC1 asserts the split batch and serial fields are present; this asserts the distinct outcome that the old combined code is absent. The view could show the split fields AND still render the combined code (AC1 green, AC2 red), so the two can be failed independently.
